Cc: security@clearsky.com, procurement@clearsky.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 / DPA / Pen test intake — multi-day mini-sprint proposal

Hi David,

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier. Rather than a single long walkthrough, our security and platform teams prefer a short multi-day intake so we can split the agenda by topic and region (APAC / EMEA / US). Proposed approach below — let me know whether this would work on your side: 

- Three 45-minute sessions over two days
  - Day 1: APAC + EMEA focused controls (45m morning APAC, 45m late EMEA)
  - Day 2: US controls + pen-test scoping (45m)
- Runbook: we’d like an ops contact and a single SFTP/Share link for evidence handoff (or DocuSign for any procurement items)
- Attendees: small set (max 6) per session — I’ll attach an initial attendee list and a draft agenda

Can you share your availability for the week of Nov 29 (Nov 29–Dec 3)? If you prefer fewer sessions, we can condense to two 60-minute blocks but we’d rather avoid an all-day meeting.

Attaching: Walkthrough-Agenda-v1.pdf, attendee-list.csv

Thanks,
Jake Morales
Senior Security Engineer
ClearSky Payments

Hi Jake — thanks for the clear plan. We’re aligned on the mini-sprint approach; it’s a good way to keep each session focused and reduce attendee churn. Quick answers and a couple of asks below.

- Availability: we can do the week of Nov 29. Suggested slots (PST):
  - Tue Nov 30 08:00–08:45 PT (APAC-friendly morning slot)
  - Tue Nov 30 16:00–16:45 PT (EMEA-friendly late afternoon)
  - Wed Dec 1 09:00–09:45 PT (US controls + pen scope)
- Ops contact / evidence: Irene Choi (irene_choi@redwood.ai) will lead evidence ingestion and the SFTP/Share setup. Irene — I’ll need a quick confirmation on retention policy and whether we should create a temporary bucket for transfer.
- Decks / artifacts: please send the attendee list as CSV (looks like the one you sent was a PDF export). We’ll prepare a short internal pre-brief and a post-session redlines doc.

I’ve attached the agenda you sent and a canonical SOC2 evidence index we use for intake. If those slots look okay, I’ll send calendar invites with per-session Zoom links and a shared Drive folder.

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of Product Security (Redwood Inference)
redwood.ai
